cards.name: Byrke, Long Ear of the Law

question: Byrke doubles the +1/+1 counters on a creature. Do replacement effects that change how many counters I put, such as Branching Evolution, apply to that ability as normal?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: replacement effects that modify the number of counters being placed apply to this ability as normal.
expected.answer: To double the number of +1/+1 counters on a creature, put a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number it already has. Replacement effects that modify the number of counters being placed on creatures you control, such as the effect of Branching Evolution, apply to this ability as normal.
